Weapons.Name: Flail of Broken Vows
Weapons.Description: A heavy iron flail wrapped in corroded sacred chains that grow heavier with the wielder's guilt.

Weapons.Name: Ethereal Soulblade
Weapons.Description: Twin daggers forged from spectral remnants that slice through physical armor directly into the enemy's soul.

Weapons.Name: Ashen Censer Mace
Weapons.Description: A hollow ceremonial mace emitting a constant mist of grey embers and funeral ash.

Weapons.Name: Sightless Stiletto
Weapons.Description: A long, needle-thin rapier without a guard, perfectly balanced for blind combatants relying on acoustic vibrations.

Weapons.Name: Greatsword of the Corrupted Commander
Weapons.Description: A rusted, notched zweihänder that echoes with the agonized screams of a fallen army.

Items.Name: Rusted Blade
Items.Description: A notched sword taken from the first battlefield.

Items.Name: Ethereal Dagger
Items.Description: A blade of condensed spirit that weighs nothing.

Items.Name: Grey Censer
Items.Description: Burns the ashes of the fallen to empower spiritual strikes.

Items.Name: Chain Vest
Items.Description: Rusty rings stitched to old leather.

Items.Name: Penitent Plate
Items.Description: Heavy armor covered in prayers. Slows the wearer.

Items.Name: Cold Ash Elixir
Items.Description: A bitter brew that stanches wounds.

Items.Name: Vigor Draught
Items.Description: Restores the will to keep walking.

Items.Name: Barbed Soul Shard
Items.Description: A crystallized relic. Combat only: +25% damage for 3 rounds, drains 5 HP.

Items.Name: Pilgrim's Lantern
Items.Description: Lights the fog. Carried: +10% success when exploring.

Items.Name: Bone Lockpick
Items.Description: Opens any path out. Carried: +15% chance to flee combat.

Items.Name: Penitent's Chain
Items.Description: A heavy iron ring. Relic: +8 DEF while equipped.

Items.Name: Obsidian Eye
Items.Description: A darkened gem that reflects the truth. Relic: +15% accuracy.

Items.Name: Seal of the Forgotten
Items.Description: A worn bronze symbol required to break the chains sealing the deeper levels.

Classes.Name: Iron Penitent
Classes.Description: A knight bent under the weight of a broken vow, bound to armor corroded by sacred chains.
Classes.AbilityDescription: Strikes with ATK plus 50% of the damage taken in the last round.

Classes.Name: Shadow Reaper
Classes.Description: The soul of a mercenary who refuses to forget his final contract, wielding blades of ethereal energy.
Classes.AbilityDescription: Ignores enemy DEF and deals 1.5x ATK as direct soul damage.

Classes.Name: Ash Bearer
Classes.Description: A former war priest who channels the remains of fallen comrades to erect shields and invoke grey flames.
Classes.AbilityDescription: Deals MAG damage, reduces enemy accuracy by 30% for 2 rounds and restores 15 SAN.

Classes.Name: Blind Inquisitor
Classes.Description: A combatant who gouged out his own sight to avoid succumbing to the hallucinations of purgatory.
Classes.AbilityDescription: Reveals the target's weak point: +35% damage taken for 3 rounds, then strikes with MAG.

Enemies.Name: Ash Wraith
Enemies.Description: A flicker of burnt soul that haunts the extinguished campfires.

Enemies.Name: Wraith of Guilt
Enemies.Description: An ethereal entity born from unresolved remorse. Drains sanity before the flesh.

Enemies.Name: Petrified Warrior
Enemies.Description: A veteran whose armor fused with the stone of Purgatory. Slow, nearly impenetrable.

Enemies.Name: Corrupted Commander
Enemies.Description: Zone boss. Your former commander, deformed by his refusal to accept defeat.

Quests.Name: Whispers in the Fog
Quests.Description: Walk the Valley of Whispers and find the two lost signposts.

Quests.Name: The Unquenchable Flame
Quests.Description: The rest campfires have gone out. Defeat 5 Ash Wraiths to rekindle them.

Quests.Name: The Broken Vow
Quests.Description: Locate and purify the 3 Altars of Penitence scattered across the map.

Quests.Name: Stone Silence
Quests.Description: Two Petrified Warriors block the bridge to the lower valley. Break them.

Quests.Name: Rescue of the Echo
Quests.Description: Find your former Commander in the depths, defeat his corrupted form and free his soul.
